title: Petition of Boston-Worcester Express Corporation of Everett, Massachusetts, for a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity, under the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 7, as amended, to authorize the operation of motor vehicles to be used in the carriage of passengers for hire, restricted to these people traveling to and from the Park Plaza Hotel, the Lenox Hotel and the Copley Square Hotel in the City of Boston.
